title: GSE circular peak geometry soft-angular hard-negative V2 three-seed training
purpose: Test whether the single pre-registered V2 peak-presence loss repairs strict circular peak recovery while retaining V1 continuous geometry capacity.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 V2 three-seed training: C01-C06 gradients, C07 checkpoint/threshold, C08 final zero-adaptation evaluation; no C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User delegated best-method decisions and continuous execution without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated causal LiDAR shards.
Sealed V2 loss readiness and V1 capacity failure.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective derived targets.

worlds.fit: Exact Cartesian S01-S10 x C01-C06: 60 worlds and the only gradient source.
worlds.selection: C07 selects checkpoints and one threshold. C08 is one final zero-adaptation development transfer and cannot change V2.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Same immutable world-wise loading, deterministic shuffling and four-column-lattice circular roll as V1; C07/C08 receive no augmentation or update.

teacher.source: Circular exact-center presence/residual/width-mask/profile plus local axis and width/height/slope/curvature masks.
teacher.use: Exact centers generate a frozen radius-4 circular soft heatmap; equal-count highest outside-support bins form hard negatives. All continuous geometry supervision is unchanged from V1.
teacher.valid_mask: Presence all bins; residual/profile exact peak bins; width independent valid peak mask; global geometry four-value mask.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid frames only; fixed 50 m sensor normalization.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No node, edge or graph is created.

split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: C07 minimum V2 total validation loss selects one checkpoint per seed; probability-mean ensemble selects maximum-recall strict local-peak threshold at precision >=0.995.
split.strict_test: C08 is one final zero-adaptation development transfer. C09/C10/M-TARE remain unread.
split.historical_pollution_audit: V1 checkpoints are attribution evidence only and forbidden as initialization; all V2 seeds start from scratch.

methods.main: V1 769268-parameter architecture from scratch with only radius-4 circular focal heatmap plus equal-count top hard-negative ranking replacing balanced exact-bin BCE.
methods.baseline: Frozen V1 exact AP 0.069034/0.057519 and raw-range AP 0.051493.
methods.fallback: If either C07 or C08 fails, stop before association/graph; do not widen angular matching, alter loss, epochs, seed, threshold or planner.

acceptance.peak_detection: Under unchanged strict exact local-maximum matching, C07-selected ensemble precision >=0.995 and recall >=0.50 on both C07 and C08; AP exceeds raw range by >=0.10 on both.
acceptance.peak_geometry: Matched peak heading MAE <=1 degree, opening-width MAE <=3 m and vertical-profile MAE <=1 m.
acceptance.global_geometry: Axis <=10 degrees; width/height <=2 m; slope <=2 degrees; curvature <=0.02 per m.
acceptance.selection: C08 checkpoint observations/updates zero; all three seeds and one ensemble threshold retained.

failure_policy: Any system drift stops. Any scientific failure yields a sealed FAIL; no retry, wide-angle rescoring, threshold relaxation, seed selection or planner compensation.
retention: Retain three checkpoints, histories, compact predictions, metrics, threshold, figures/source, environment, logs, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Three sequential CUDA trainings plus development evaluation
